sentences.en: You have to endure a lot of hardships in life.
sentences.zh: 生活中你必须忍受很多艰难困苦。

sentences.en: I could only feel pity for what they were enduring.
sentences.zh: 我只能为他们正在承受的一切感到同情。

sentences.en: Sami endured a sustained attack involving at least three weapons.
sentences.zh: 萨米遭受了至少涉及三种武器的持续攻击。
